description: First repeatable NASA image acquisition batch; all images remain subject to independent editorial review.

images.title: The Sun in extreme ultraviolet
images.summary: NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory imaged the Sun on September 10, 2025. The golden color represents ultraviolet intensity rather than the Sun's visible-light color.
images.alt: Detailed glowing yellow-gold solar disk with active regions and wisps of corona against black space.
images.caption: A view of the Sun in a 171-angstrom extreme-ultraviolet band. This instrument image is rendered in false color, allowing hot solar structures to be seen.
images.rights: NASA science image; generally not subject to U.S. copyright, subject to NASA Media Usage Guidelines.
images.processing: NASA false-color 171-angstrom scientific image; resized to maximum edge 1800 pixels and saved as quality-87 JPEG without additional color remapping. NASA source original is linked.

images.title: Antarctica in summer, from orbit
images.summary: NASA Aqua MODIS imagery acquired January 27, 2009 depicts the continent's ice, surrounding seas and clouds. Several orbital passes were combined to form this mosaic.
images.alt: Large ice-white Antarctic continent surrounded by dark southern ocean and pale swirling cloud systems.
images.caption: A satellite mosaic shows Antarctica during the continuous summer daylight. This is a composite of several overpasses, not a single camera exposure.
images.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / MODIS Rapid Response Team, NASA GSFC
images.rights: NASA Earth Observatory imagery; generally not subject to U.S. copyright, subject to NASA Media Usage Guidelines.
images.processing: NASA MODIS composite of multiple orbital passes. Downsampled to maximum edge 1800 pixels and saved as quality-87 JPEG; original acquisition link retained.

images.title: Aurora over Earth's night side
images.summary: Photographed from the International Space Station on September 7, 2026, auroral light glows above Earth's limb. Atmospheric atoms and molecules radiate after excitation associated with the solar wind.
images.alt: Thin green and purple auroral arcs above the dark curve of Earth, with distant city lights visible.
images.caption: An ISS view of a green and purple aurora. NASA cropped the photograph, enhanced contrast and removed lens artifacts.
images.credit: NASA / Expedition 75 crew / ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility
images.rights: NASA astronaut photograph; generally not subject to U.S. copyright, subject to NASA Media Usage Guidelines.
images.processing: NASA cropped image, enhanced contrast and removed lens artifacts; the NASA derivative is resized to maximum edge 1800 pixels and saved as quality-87 JPEG.
